q: Which land can be planted for CCTS credits under methodology BM FR05.002?
title: Afforestation under BM FR05.002
short: Any land that is not wetland, and it need not be degraded. BM FR05.002 limits soil disturbance to 10 per cent of the area on organic soils and on land whose soil carbon is expected to be higher than under forestry. It is adapted from the UN CDM method AR-ACM0003.
audience: Forestry developers, farmers with agroforestry plans and CSR teams

ul: The land does not fall in the wetland category.
Soil disturbance from the project covers no more than 10 per cent of the area on organic soils, and on land whose baseline use is expected to hold more soil organic carbon than forestry would.
The applicability conditions of the forestry tools used also apply.
Adapted from UNFCCC CDM methodology AR-ACM0003 (version valid from 4 October 2013).
Uses BEE's A/R tools for baseline and additionality, burning, dead wood and litter, trees and shrubs, displaced farming, and soil carbon.

senseible: Senseible does not measure forest carbon stocks.
